balance: completed UTC day; 64-bin turnover profile; open/close inside 70% value area; both UTC halves trade both sides of POC
entry: fixed 500ms after decision, conservatively first strictly later 1m open
event: first next-day raid of one balance edge, first completed 5m reclaim, then first completed 5m close beyond opposite edge before raid-extreme invalidation
gate: 2022 >=50 trades, ordinary positive at 18/24bp, 24bp PF>1, exact top-10%-positive-event deletion plus full slot reroute positive
logic: true completed two-sided balance -> next-day one-edge raid -> completed reclaim inside -> completed opposite-edge close -> distribution to nearest live external pool
state_loss: completed 5m close back inside old balance; execute at first later 1m open
target: nearest available and still-unconsumed prior-10-day daily or confirmed 4h external pool
